# Blazar Lens

> > Blazar Lens manufactures professional anamorphic cinema lenses including MANTIS, REMUS-M, Cato, Vertiscope, Talon, and Apex series with support for PL, EF, E, RF, L, and Z mounts.

Blazar Lens specializes in full-frame and APS-C anamorphic lenses for cinematography, offering 1.33X and 1.5X squeeze ratios. The site provides technical specifications, rental directories, firmware updates, and mount compatibility guides for professional filmmakers.

## Key Topics

- MANTIS 1.33X Anamorphic Lenses
- REMUS-M 1.5X Anamorphic
- Cato 40mm Cinema Lens
- Vertiscope Anamorphic
- Talon Lens Series
- Apex Lens Series
- PL Mount
- EF Mount
- E-Z Mount Adapter
- Full Frame Anamorphic
- Cinema Lenses
- Lens Rental Directory
- Anamorphic Cinematography
- Sony Camera Compatibility
- Firmware Updates

## Product Catalog

- [BLAZAR | Mantis 1.33X Full Frame Anamorphic](https://blazarlens.com/mantis): Mantis 1.33X full frame anamorphic lens with PL/EF mount options
- [EXPLORE - Blazar Lens](https://blazarlens.com/explore): Product catalog featuring MANTIS, REMUS-M, and Vertiscope anamorphic lenses

- [SPECS - Blazar Lens](https://blazarlens.com/specs): Technical specifications for Remus, Cato, and Mantis anamorphic lenses
